aspectLED is hiring a Shopify Frontend Developer to own day-to-day storefront theme development and delivery for its Shopify website. The role maintains and improves theme code, builds pages and features, resolves storefront tickets, and partners with the Backend Engineer when changes require data or Admin integration support.
Electronics
Manufacturing
Semiconductor
Responsibilities
Maintain and optimize Shopify theme code, including Liquid, sections, snippets, templates, and assets
Build and update pages, templates, and storefront features from approved engineering tickets
Implement technical SEO improvements and support storefront performance and accessibility fixes as assigned
Use the Git/GitHub-to-Shopify workflow to develop in Ticket-Dev or CRO-Dev and promote approved changes through staging to production
Follow the established deployment playbook and obtain Senior Digital Platform Manager approval before production releases; do not bypass the workflow with direct theme pushes
Maintain accurate ticket statuses, handoffs, and change documentation in the engineering system of record (Linear)
Own pre-release QA for the homepage, product detail pages, cart, and affected landing or CRO pages on desktop and mobile
Troubleshoot and resolve Shopify theme issues and support tickets through completion
Review AI-generated theme changes, verify their quality, and correct or reject unsupported changes before staging
Perform Shopify Admin tasks related to storefront delivery, including template assignments, page visibility, and merchandising handoffs
Collaborate with the Backend Engineer when storefront work depends on metafields, Admin behavior, or integrations
Support Merchandising, Design, and Marketing with approved site enhancements and conversion experiments

Required
1–3 years of Shopify theme, storefront frontend, or related web development experience; strong internship or project work considered
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with the ability to learn and work deeply in Shopify Liquid
Familiarity with Git and pull-request-based development workflows
Ability to test and troubleshoot work across desktop and mobile experiences
Clear written communication for tickets, handoffs, and release notes
Strong attention to detail, sound judgment when evaluating AI-assisted work, and commitment to reliable implementation
Preferred
Experience with Shopify Online Store 2.0, JSON templates, or theme app extensions
Familiarity with eCommerce merchandising workflows and B2B or trade customers
Understanding of CRO experiments, A/B testing, and measurement hygiene
Experience using Chrome DevTools, Lighthouse, or similar frontend debugging tools
